newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks slightly off in quiet, steady trade.
newsitem.headline: French stocks slightly off in quiet, steady trade.

text.p: French stocks remain slightly weaker at midday on consolidation of recent gains in quiet trading due to U.S. July 4 holiday.
* CAC-40 index down 8.24 points, or 0.28 percent, at 2,928.74 at 1030 GMT
* CAC-40 July futures down four at 2,936
* Morgan Stanley cuts rating on LVMH to underperform. LVMH stock, which hit year high on Thursday, off 0.85 percent.
